lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple horizontal rows of high-luminance circular blobs are visible on the lateral flank; the most prominent row consists of 5-6 distinct clusters located mid-body, posterior to the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical columns of increased pixel intensity intersect the primary horizontal rows of blobs, creating a localized grid-like appearance particularly evident in the mid-flank region.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A distinct horizontal ridge feature is visible along the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal side and shadow on the ventral side.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant notch-like indentation is visible on the posterior trailing edge of the left pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: High-density concentration of smaller, lower-intensity high-luminance blobs localized on the dorsal surface of the head region, anterior to the gills.
